current.text: Tyrese Haliburton is back with Indiana. Siakam is in the projected starting five with Haliburton, Nembhard, Nesmith and Zubac.
With Haliburton back, his assists should fall to about 3 to 3.2 per game and his usage should drop back under 30.
In category leagues he is worth a pick in the 50 to 60 range. Picks 45 to 51 are a little early.
His ESPN rank of 24 to 25 is far too high. Never take him that early in a category league.
Age is a question for him at 32.
Coach Rick Carlisle often keeps minutes low for healthy players and rests players on back-to-backs. Indiana has 15 back-to-backs.
Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, which is not ideal.
Indiana is projected to win 46 to 48 games and finish as a top six seed in the East.

durable.text: He is a much better points league player than category league player.
Points are his best category, and he adds a positive FG% on high volume for a forward.
He is not a great free throw shooter and is weak in the defensive stats. Blocks and FT% are his weak categories.
The last time he played next to Haliburton, his assists were way down.
He has one of the tightest game-to-game production ranges in the NBA, about 22 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists every game.
He plays through minor problems and plays a lot when he is able to.

note: The experts value him around picks 50 to 60 in category leagues, which matches his Yahoo rank of 61 and Yahoo value of 17 USD. He is not worth the ESPN value of 29 USD or the 25 USD our league paid last season. His points and FG% on volume plus a weak FT% make him a natural fit for punt FT% builds, and his steady game-to-game output is a plus in head-to-head. Early in the season, check how far his assists and usage fall next to Haliburton and whether Carlisle trims his minutes. Indiana's 3-4-3 playoff schedule is a small minus.
